title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP05a-auth — change-trusted-base authorization for authorization consumption
goal: Add the base change-trusted-base authorization that the CP05a fix PR will consume, record D20 on exact authorization consumption and the one-time break-glass, and provide the break-glass runbook and ruleset snapshot plan for review, without changing any trusted component.
acceptanceCriteria: The authorization record is schema-valid, generated from the prepared fix revision, and lists exactly its trusted component paths, base and head tuples and validation suites.
D20 records that only the base-verified consumed authorization deletion is exempt from protected deletions and that the fix lands once through section 11.7 break-glass.

The runbook covers read-only checks, before, during and after ruleset snapshots, the single-context temporary change, merge, restoration, remote CI contract proof, abort conditions and post-restore verification.
No trusted component changes, nothing is deleted, and all 13 required checks pass.
